items.html: *In the Zohar, page 72, column 1, 'And these are the names, etc.,' and 'the wise shall shine: these are they who look into the secret of wisdom. They shall shine — illuminate and sparkle with the radiance of the upper wisdom, etc.' Behold, all the Atzilut in its entirety is body and soul, from without and from within; and the wise are those who know judgment, who look into the internality of the lower wisdom, in the secret of the soul.
